caption: The video captures a macro view of pale white smoke drifting and curling around a dark, roughly vertical object studded with small light-colored flaky fragments. The smoke is the dominant moving element, continuously changing shape and density as it swirls and drifts past the object rather than translating as a single block. At several points a brighter, more opaque white puff wells up on the left side of the object before thinning and dispersing into the haze. The degree to which the smoke veils the central object varies over time, sometimes partly obscuring it and sometimes letting its dark surface and flakes show through. The solid object itself holds essentially the same position from first frame to last, without observable translation or rotation, while blurred diagonal lines remain in the dim background at the left. A steady red glow sits at the lower-right corner throughout. The swirling motion is already underway at the opening and continues without resolution to the close, leaving the process visibly in progress at both ends.
relations: Smoke drifting past the fixed dark object causes its veil density to vary, intermittently revealing the flaky fragments.
A brighter puff welling on the left side thins and disperses into the surrounding haze over time.
The steady red glow at the lower-right corner persists while the smoke swirls and changes shape.
Blurred diagonal background lines remain static as the smoke continuously curls around the central object.
